author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಬೆರಳುಗಳು ಸಮವಿಲ್ಲ ಮುಷ್ಟಿಯಾದರೆ ಶಕ್ತಿ
ತರತಮವ ಕಳೆಯುತಿರೆ ಸಂಘಟನೆ ಬಲವು
ಕರವಜೋಡಿಸೆ ಕ್ರಾಂತಿ ಸರಿಯಿರಲು ಸಂಕ್ರಾಂತಿ
ತರುವುದದೆ ಪಲ್ಲಟವ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Fingers are not equal; made into a fist, they are strong;
when differences are shed, the union has strength;
joining hands brings revolution; when it is right, a new turning;
that is what brings change, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Fingers differ in length but together make a fist. When we set aside differences and join hands, real change becomes possible.
